title: Making Mushroom Ketchup - 18th Century Cooking
summary: The Townsends channel shows how to make mushroom ketchup, a popular 18th-century sauce, in period style. It includes the history and a recipe and links to a blog post on whether George Washington used ketchup.
why: HN commenters who have cooked it recommend it as a reliable, delicious recipe and a good historical explanation of pre-tomato ketchup.

quote.text: The Mushroom Ketchup recipe is one I repeatedly go back to -- it's just that good
